artifacts.delta_brief: Between 2020 and 2021, NVDA continues to emphasize manufacturing and cybersecurity as core risk exposure (2020 para 24; 2021 para 43). The earlier filing is relatively more anchored in manufacturing, while the later filing adds clearer weight to cybersecurity (2020 para 56; 2021 para 47). Across both years, management frames these items as operational and financial execution pressures rather than isolated one-off events (2020 para 24; 2021 para 47). This comparison should be read as directional because the lens is a focuspack subset and not the full Item 1A text (2020 para 56; 2021 para 43). Overall, the narrative indicates continuity with selective shifts in emphasis instead of a full thematic reset (2020 para 24; 2021 para 43).
